Asia/Singapore uses UTC+8 (historical offset for 1498 is not defined, but we assume standard offset as per rules: UTC+8).  
Europe/Athens uses UTC+2.  

target_time = source_time + (target_utc_offset - source_utc_offset)  
= 21:00 + (2 - 8)  
= 21:00 + (-6)  
= 15:00 same day.  

Date unchanged (no crossing midnight in this subtraction).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 15:00
